question_text: Mark the word whose underlined part differs from the other three in pronunciation.
explanation: "flood" phát âm là /ʌ/, các từ còn lại phát âm là /u:/.

question_text: Mark the word whose underlined part differs from the other three in pronunciation.
explanation: "articles" phát âm đuôi -s là /z/, các từ còn lại phát âm là /ɪz/.

question_text: Mark the word that differs from the other three in the position of primary stress: suppose, purpose, improve, delay
explanation: "purpose" nhấn trọng âm 1, các từ còn lại nhấn trọng âm 2.

question_text: Mark the word that differs from the other three in the position of primary stress: delivery, inexpensive, generation, scientific
explanation: "delivery" nhấn trọng âm 2, các từ còn lại nhấn trọng âm 3.

question_text: It _____ heavily when we finished school yesterday afternoon.
explanation: Hành động đang diễn ra trong quá khứ (was raining) thì hành động khác cắt ngang (finished).

question_text: _____ we arrived late, we didn't miss the first part of the speech.
explanation: "Even though" đi với một mệnh đề chỉ sự nhượng bộ; "Despite/In spite of" đi với cụm danh từ/V-ing.

question_text: I wish I _____ an electric bike. I'm tired of catching the bus to school every day.
explanation: Câu ước ở hiện tại: S + wish + S + V-past (had).

question_text: Of all the factors affecting agricultural yields, weather is the one _____.
explanation: Đại từ quan hệ "that" làm chủ ngữ thay thế cho đại từ "the one" (chỉ thời tiết).

question_text: David must be out of the _____ of arriving late for meetings.
explanation: Cụm cố định: "out of the habit of doing sth" (bỏ thói quen làm gì).

question_text: My sister's hobby is ______ old postcards.
explanation: Cụm từ: "collecting postcards" (sưu tầm bưu thiếp).

question_text: - "What shall we do this weekend?" - "_____ "
opt_b: Let's go outing to the zoo
explanation: Đáp lại câu hỏi gợi ý/đề xuất dùng "Let's + V".

question_text: I'm sorry, but we do not have _____ knowledge about the new transit system of the city.
explanation: "Knowledge" là danh từ không đếm được, trong câu phủ định dùng "much".

question_text: What to Do after Super Typhoon: 2. Make sure your loved ones are fine; check to see if there is (13) _____ damage.
explanation: Dùng "any" trong câu nghi vấn/mệnh đề if để chỉ "bất kỳ thiệt hại nào".

question_text: 3. Be alert for high water in areas where rivers may cause (14) _____ due to heavy rains.
explanation: "due to heavy rains" (do mưa lớn) dẫn đến "flooding" (ngập lụt).

question_text: 4. Check the area around the house. Remove (15) _____ trees and plants.
explanation: Cần quá khứ phân từ "broken" đóng vai trò tính từ (cây bị gãy/đổ).

question_text: 6. Don't touch the loose and dangling wire (16) _____ lamp posts: it may have electric current.
explanation: Dây điện lòng thòng "từ" cột đèn: "from lamp posts".

question_text: Put the sentences (a-c) in the correct order, then fill in the blank to make a logical text about Ha Long Bay.
explanation: Trình tự logic: Cách di chuyển đến (b) → Cảnh quan tổng thể 2.000 đảo (a) → Cảnh quan hang động (c).

question_text: Choose the sentence that can end the text (in Question 17) most appropriately.
opt_a: Besides visiting famous attractions, tourists can do various activities there.
opt_b: Many tourists never know about Ha Long Bay.
opt_c: Quang Ninh has a lot of beautiful sights for foreigners.
opt_d: Delicious sea food and local cuisine are among specialities of Quang Ninh.
explanation: Câu A liên kết chặt chẽ nhất với việc tổng kết các hoạt động trải nghiệm sau khi giới thiệu cảnh đẹp.

question_text: Regular physical activity helps people (19) _____ fit and strong.
explanation: Cụm từ cố định: "stay fit" (giữ gìn vóc dáng/sức khỏe).

question_text: When we exercise, our bodies release chemicals (20) _____.
explanation: Rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ dạng bị động: "chemicals (which are) called endorphins".

question_text: This is why we feel less stressed and (21) _____ after playing sports or working out.
explanation: Cấu trúc song hành với "less stressed" (ít căng thẳng hơn và thư giãn hơn: "more relaxed").

question_text: Many people have (22) _____ because of stress or spending too much time on their phones.
explanation: Cấu trúc: "have trouble + V-ing" (gặp khó khăn khi chìm vào giấc ngủ).

question_text: Good sleep is important for (23) _____ and energy during the day.
explanation: "concentration" (sự tập trung) phù hợp với ngữ cảnh làm việc/học tập ban ngày cùng với năng lượng.

question_text: In conclusion, exercising (24) _____ is a simple but effective way for us to improve health.
explanation: Trạng từ "regularly" (thường xuyên, đều đặn) bổ nghĩa cho động từ exercising.

question_text: You won't get into secondary school without passing your exam.
opt_a: Unless you pass your exam, you can't get into secondary school.
opt_b: If you pass your exam, you can't get into secondary school.
opt_c: Passing your exam does not mean you can enter secondary school.
opt_d: You can get into secondary school and then pass your exam.
explanation: Chuyển đổi điều kiện: "without passing" = "Unless you pass" (Nếu bạn không đỗ kỳ thi).

question_text: She was irresponsible at times, so she lost her job.
opt_a: She stayed on her job though she was irresponsible at times.
opt_b: She was responsible all the time; therefore, she was dismissed.
opt_c: She was dismissed because she was irresponsible sometimes.
opt_d: The reason why she was sacked was that she responded quickly.
explanation: "lost her job" = "was dismissed" (bị sa thải); "so" chuyển thành liên từ nguyên nhân "because".

question_text: While she / water / flowers / her garden / start / rain
opt_a: While she was watering the flowers in her garden, it started to rain.
opt_b: While she watered flowers in her garden, it started to be raining.
opt_c: While she is watering the flowers in her garden, it started to rain.
opt_d: While she watered the flowers in her garden, it was starting to rain.
explanation: Cấu trúc While + QK tiếp diễn (was watering), QK đơn (started).

question_text: monuments / vital part / cultural heritage / our country
opt_a: There are monuments a vital part of the cultural heritage of our country.
opt_b: These monuments are vital parts in the cultural heritage of our country.
opt_c: These monuments are a vital part of the cultural heritage of our country.
opt_d: The monuments serve a vital part of the cultural heritage for our country.
explanation: Cụm chuẩn: "a vital part of the cultural heritage of our country".

question_text: What does this sign say?
opt_a: You can ride your bicycle here.
opt_b: You can ride your bicycle by yourself.
opt_c: Only bicycles can be used here.
explanation: Biển cấm xe đạp biểu thị "forbidden" (bị cấm).

question_text: What does the notice say?
opt_a: If you want to visit, you have to inform the school.
opt_b: Visitors must write a report to the school office.
opt_c: Everyone can visit the school office.
opt_d: All visitors are free to come to school office.
explanation: "report to office" đồng nghĩa với việc phải thông báo cho ban quản lý/trường học trước khi vào.

question_text: The word "simpler" in the first paragraph is CLOSEST in meaning to _____.
explanation: "simpler" (đơn giản hơn) đồng nghĩa với "easier" (dễ dàng hơn).

question_text: According to the passage, which of the following is still important in modern Vietnamese life?
explanation: Thông tin đoạn 2: "Family meals are still important...".

question_text: The word "remain" in the second paragraph is OPPOSITE in meaning to _____.
explanation: "remain" (ở lại, duy trì) trái nghĩa với "leave" (rời đi, biến mất).

question_text: Which of the following statements is NOT true according to the passage?
opt_a: Traditional Vietnamese houses were made of wood or bamboo.
opt_b: Social media is popular among the younger generation in Viet Nam.
opt_c: Vietnamese people no longer celebrate festivals like Tet.
opt_d: People in modern Viet Nam often live in apartments or modern houses.
explanation: Đoạn văn nêu "...continue to celebrate festivals like Tet" nên câu C (không còn ăn Tết) là sai.

question_text: What is the main idea of the passage?
opt_a: Vietnamese people no longer follow any of their old traditions.
opt_b: Young people in Viet Nam are forgetting their roots due to globalization.
opt_c: Technology has completely replaced traditional farming in Viet Nam.
opt_d: Vietnamese lifestyle has modernized, but the core values remain strong.
explanation: Ý chính toàn bài: Cuộc sống hiện đại hóa nhưng các giá trị cốt lõi vẫn được giữ vững.

question_text: Which of the following can be the best title for the passage?
opt_d: Modern Technology in Viet Nam now
explanation: Nhan đề bao quát toàn diện sự thay đổi lối sống từ quá khứ (Then) đến hiện tại (Now).

question_text: In the countryside, people would often walk or ride bicycles (37) _____.
opt_a: and countries like Viet Nam are developing metro systems in major cities
opt_b: Cars are becoming more common too, especially for middle-class families.
opt_c: Boats were used a lot in rivers and canals.
opt_d: to go to the market or visit family members
explanation: Cụm chỉ mục đích di chuyển ở nông thôn: "để đi chợ hoặc thăm người thân".

question_text: Long-distance travel was slow, and only a few people owned cars or motorcycles. (38) _____.
opt_a: and countries like Viet Nam are developing metro systems in major cities
opt_b: Cars are becoming more common too, especially for middle-class families.
opt_c: Boats were used a lot in rivers and canals.
opt_d: to go to the market or visit family members
explanation: Bổ sung phương tiện di chuyển đường thủy thời xưa: "Thuyền được sử dụng nhiều trên sông ngòi".

question_text: Motorbikes are the most popular form of transportation, especially in cities in developing countries. (39) _____.
opt_a: and countries like Viet Nam are developing metro systems in major cities
opt_b: Cars are becoming more common too, especially for middle-class families.
opt_c: Boats were used a lot in rivers and canals.
opt_d: to go to the market or visit family members
explanation: Nối tiếp phương tiện hiện đại: Sau xe máy đến ô tô ngày càng phổ biến.

question_text: Public transportation, like buses or trains, is now widely available, (40) _____.
opt_a: and countries like Viet Nam are developing metro systems in major cities
opt_b: Cars are becoming more common too, especially for middle-class families.
opt_c: Boats were used a lot in rivers and canals.
opt_d: to go to the market or visit family members
explanation: Bổ sung ví dụ về giao thông công cộng hiện đại: hệ thống tàu điện ngầm metro.

question_text: Mark the word whose underlined part differs from the other three in pronunciation.
explanation: "slowly" có phần gạch chân phát âm là /oʊ/, các từ còn lại phát âm là /aʊ/.

question_text: Mark the word whose underlined part differs from the other three in pronunciation.
explanation: "modern" có chữ 'o' phát âm là /ɒ/, các từ còn lại phát âm là /ə/.

question_text: Mark the word that differs from the other three in the position of primary stress: fabulous, reliable, variety, forbidden
explanation: "fabulous" trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết 1, các từ còn lại trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết 2.

question_text: Mark the word that differs from the other three in the position of primary stress: pricey, metro, advance, process
explanation: "advance" trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết 2, các từ còn lại trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết 1.

question_text: The sky train is ______ with commuters at rush hour.
explanation: Cụm từ cố định "packed with" mang nghĩa đông đúc, chật ních người (full đi với of).

question_text: It is often more ______ to live in the downtown than in the suburbs.
explanation: Dựa vào ngữ cảnh so sánh sự tiện lợi khi sống ở trung tâm thành phố.

question_text: The ______ the public transport system is, the ______ it is for residents to get around the city.
explanation: Cấu trúc so sánh kép: The + comparative..., the + comparative... (Hệ thống càng đáng tin cậy thì càng dễ đi lại).

question_text: My phone battery is low, so I need to ______ my phone to save power for the meeting.
explanation: Pin yếu nên cần tắt máy (turn off my phone) để giữ pin cho cuộc họp. Lưu ý: với đại từ phải tách cụm động từ: turn it off, không viết "turn off it".

question_text: We've ______ all the milk; we need to buy more.
explanation: Cụm động từ "run out of" có nghĩa là dùng hết, cạn kiệt thứ gì.

question_text: During ______ traffic can be very heavy and slow-moving.
explanation: Cụm từ "rush hour" (giờ cao điểm) phù hợp với ngữ cảnh giao thông đông đúc, ùn tắc.

question_text: ______ smoother ______ traffic flow in the downtown area, ______ better the commute for workers.
explanation: Cấu trúc so sánh đồng tiến: The + comparative + N..., the + comparative + N...

question_text: Linda: "Would you mind opening the window?" - Jane: "______"
explanation: "Not at all" là cách phản hồi lịch sự đồng ý khi được hỏi với "Would you mind...?".

question_text: This event will showcase (13) ______ vibrant culture and activities of our city.
explanation: Sử dụng mạo từ xác định "the" để chỉ nét văn hóa đặc trưng đã được xác định của thành phố.

question_text: ...showcase the vibrant culture and (14) ______ activities of our city.
explanation: Vị trí cần một tính từ đứng trước danh từ "activities" để bổ nghĩa.

question_text: Join us (15) ______ Central Park for a day filled with music, and fun.
explanation: Giới từ "at" dùng để chỉ một địa điểm cụ thể (at Central Park).

question_text: There will be performances from local bands, (16) ______ a food market featuring international cuisine.
explanation: Dùng hiện tại phân từ "including" đóng vai trò như một giới từ mang nghĩa "bao gồm".

question_text: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct arrangement of the sentences to make a meaningful letter.
explanation: Trật tự logic của bức thư: Mở đầu nêu lý do (c) -> Ý bổ trợ 1 (b) -> Ý bổ trợ 2 (d) -> Ý tương phản (a) -> Kết thư (e).

question_text: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct arrangement of the sentences to make a meaningful paragraph.
explanation: Trật tự logic đoạn văn: Câu chủ đề (a) -> Ví dụ minh họa (b) -> Ý bổ sung thuận lợi (c) -> Nhận định 2 mặt (e) -> Ý tương phản (d).

question_text: The city is known (19) ______ its lively atmosphere and diverse population.
explanation: Cụm cấu trúc "be known for" mang nghĩa là nổi tiếng, được biết đến vì điều gì.

question_text: (20) ______ the high cost of living, many people find the urban environment stimulating.
explanation: "Despite" đi với cụm danh từ "the high cost of living" để chỉ sự nhượng bộ (mặc dù).

question_text: The city's landscape is filled with (21) ______ landmarks and modern architecture.
explanation: "historic landmarks" là cụm từ chuẩn chỉ các công trình, địa danh mang ý nghĩa lịch sử quan trọng.

question_text: (22) ______ the hustle and bustle of daily life, residents often find solace in the city's green spaces.
explanation: "Despite + Noun phrase" diễn tả sự nhượng bộ, tương phản giữa nhịp sống hối hả và chốn bình yên.

question_text: The vibrant energy of the city (23) ______ it an appealing place for those who enjoy an active lifestyle.
explanation: Chủ ngữ "The vibrant energy" là danh từ không đếm được/số ít, đi với cấu trúc "make sth + adj/noun".

question_text: (24) ______ you're looking for excitement or relaxation, the city provides plenty of options.
explanation: Cấu trúc lựa chọn: "Whether... or..." (Cho dù bạn tìm kiếm sự sôi động hay thư giãn).

question_text: Mary doesn't study as well as she used to.
opt_a: Mary used to study worse than she does now.
opt_b: Mary used to study better than she does now.
opt_c: As time flew, Mary studies better.
opt_d: Mary doesn't use good studying methods now.
explanation: Viết lại câu so sánh bằng sang so sánh hơn: Trước đây Mary học tốt hơn bây giờ.

question_text: My current house is more spacious than the old one.
opt_a: My old house is smaller the current one.
opt_b: My current house is the most spacious house.
opt_c: My old house is smaller than the current one.
opt_d: My old house had more space than the new one.
explanation: Chuyển đổi câu so sánh hơn giữa hai vế đối lập: Nhà hiện tại rộng hơn = Nhà cũ nhỏ hơn.

question_text: Some cities/ be/ not safe/ high crime rates.
opt_a: Some cities are not safe because high crime rates.
opt_b: Some cities are not safe because of high crime rates.
opt_c: Some cities is not safe because of high crime rates.
opt_d: Some cities are unsafe for people because high in crime rates.
explanation: "high crime rates" là một cụm danh từ nên phải dùng liên từ chỉ nguyên nhân "because of".

question_text: The town's/ public amenities/ make/ liveable place/ its residents.
opt_a: The town's public amenities make it a liveable place for its residents.
opt_b: The town's public amenities makes it a liveable place for its residents.
opt_c: The town's public amenities make liveable place for its residents.
opt_d: The town's public amenities makes liveable place for its residents.
explanation: Chủ ngữ "amenities" số nhiều nên động từ "make" giữ nguyên thể và cần tân ngữ giả "it".

question_text: What does the sign say?
opt_a: You can park your car in any place.
opt_b: Do not park your car here.
opt_c: Only customers can park in this area.
opt_d: You can park your car in any spot you like.
explanation: Biển báo "No Parking" có nghĩa là cấm đỗ xe tại khu vực này.

question_text: What does the notice say?
opt_a: If you open this soup, keep it in the fridge for at least two days.
opt_b: Once you open this soup, keep it in the fridge for no more than two days.
opt_c: Put this soup in the fridge as soon as you open it.
opt_d: If you open this soup, you shouldn't keep it in the fridge.
explanation: Thông báo: sau khi mở, không để súp trong tủ lạnh quá 2 ngày ("no more than two days").

question_text: What is the passage mainly about?
opt_b: The benefits and challenges of public transportation in cities
opt_c: The differences between public transportation in Tokyo and New York
opt_d: The environmental impact of private vehicles
explanation: Bài đọc phân tích tổng thể cả lợi ích (tiết kiệm, giảm khí thải) và thách thức (xuống cấp, quá tải) của giao thông công cộng.

question_text: The word "punctuality" in paragraph 2 is CLOSEST in meaning to ______
explanation: "Punctuality" nghĩa là sự đúng giờ, đồng nghĩa với "timeliness".

question_text: According to the passage, what is the benefit of public transportation?
explanation: Thông tin trong bài: "reducing the number of private vehicles... help to lower emissions".

question_text: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as a challenge for public transportation?
explanation: Bài đọc nhắc tới aging infrastructure, lack of funding, overcrowding; không nhắc tới high fuel costs như một thách thức của hệ thống.

question_text: The word "expand" in the passage is OPPOSITE in meaning to ______
explanation: "expand" có nghĩa là mở rộng, phát triển; trái nghĩa là "reduce" (thu nhỏ, cắt giảm).

question_text: What is one of the biggest challenges for public transportation systems?
opt_a: Too many train lines in small cities
opt_c: Aging infrastructure and lack of funding
opt_d: The high cost of private vehicles
explanation: Dẫn chứng trong bài: "...challenges: in many cities, aging infrastructure and lack of funding can lead to delays...".

question_text: ...the availability of good and reliable health services (37) ______ is an important aspect...
opt_a: so that buying daily necessities is quicker and simpler
opt_b: ranging from parks and recreational spaces to cultural institutions and educational facilities
opt_d: the combination of these factors collectively contributes to a vibrant and livable urban lifestyle
explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ "that are available whenever needed" bổ nghĩa cho danh từ "health services".

question_text: Second, there are numerous markets and malls, (38) ______.
opt_a: so that buying daily necessities is quicker and simpler
opt_b: ranging from parks and recreational spaces to cultural institutions and educational facilities
opt_d: the combination of these factors collectively contributes to a vibrant and livable urban lifestyle
explanation: Mệnh đề chỉ mục đích/kết quả "so that buying daily necessities is quicker and simpler" tiếp nối ý mua sắm ở các chợ và trung tâm thương mại.

question_text: Third, cities offer a wealth of public amenities, (39) ______, making city living a well-rounded and fulfilling experience.
opt_a: so that buying daily necessities is quicker and simpler
opt_b: ranging from parks and recreational spaces to cultural institutions and educational facilities
opt_d: the combination of these factors collectively contributes to a vibrant and livable urban lifestyle
explanation: Cụm phân từ "ranging from... to..." liệt kê chi tiết các loại hình tiện ích công cộng.

question_text: In conclusion, (40) ______, and enhances the quality of city life.
opt_a: so that buying daily necessities is quicker and simpler
opt_b: ranging from parks and recreational spaces to cultural institutions and educational facilities
opt_d: the combination of these factors collectively contributes to a vibrant and livable urban lifestyle
explanation: Mệnh đề kết luận tóm lược lại toàn bộ các yếu tố tạo nên lối sống đô thị sôi động và đáng sống.

question_text: Mark the letter A, B, C or D... Most Vietnamese families... a. Secondly... b. That's the way... c. Thirdly...
explanation: Sắp xếp thứ tự logic của đoạn văn về phong tục tập quán.

question_text: Choose the sentence that can end the text above most appropriately.
opt_a: In this way, they keep their traditions alive...
opt_b: Finally, every generation can live happily...
opt_d: They also show their interests in all festivals...
explanation: Câu kết luận phù hợp nhất để tổng kết ý nghĩa truyền thống.

question_text: Last week I (3) ____ back to my village and was really surprised.
explanation: Chia thì quá khứ đơn với chủ ngữ 'I'.

question_text: The lake is not (4) ____ anymore.
explanation: Dùng tính từ/phân từ 'polluted' sau động từ 'is not'.

question_text: I saw (5) ____ fish in the lake and wild ducks swimming in the water.
explanation: Dùng 'lots of' đi với danh từ đếm được số nhiều 'fish'.

question_text: Besides, they have planted trees around the factory to (6) ____ air pollution.
explanation: Cụm từ 'reduce air pollution' (giảm ô nhiễm không khí).

question_text: This has resulted in (7) ____ much cleaner environment.
explanation: Dùng mạo từ 'a' trước cụm danh từ đếm được số ít bắt đầu bằng phụ âm ("a much cleaner environment")

question_text: What about your neighbourhood? Has anything been done... Tell me all (8) ____ it in your next email.
